logic_summary: Body (verified vs disasm @0x3347c): (1) __CHK(0x28) Watcom frame-size stack probe (not source body); (2) fd2_init_battle_state_for_chapter(); (3) fd2_pan_cursor_and_window(0x14, 0x14); (4) fd2_display_dialog_scene(data_fd2_current_chapter_text, 0, 0xa0000, 0x140, 0xcd, 0x4c, 0x4a, 0x13, 1) -- dialog page 0; (5) fd2_pan_cursor_to_char(0). No cutscene, no portrait load, no char init, no clear-facing, and notably NO data_fd2_battle_anim_phase reset (disasm has no MOV [...],0).
